title: Concept: Prefect UI is reachable without authentication
description: An orchestration UI holds the flow code references, the schedules and the run logs, which name the storage and compute the pipeline touches. Its API also triggers runs, so exposure is both a disclosure and a way to move data.
applicability: Responses from a self-hosted Prefect server on a reachable host.
risk: The caller reads run logs that name internal storage, and can trigger deployments that move or transform data.
